references.text: Achan confesses what he took, which is now being brought out from his tent
The stolen items laid before the Lord lead to Achan's judgment and punishment
Another situation where something is presented before the Lord for judgment
Samuel gathers the people before the Lord to expose sin, a theme similar to presenting matters before God
Israel gathers and pours out water before the face of the Lord as a sign of confession and cleansing
The original prohibition against taking from what was devoted to destruction, which Achan broke
